user.title: Bill Tracker
user.description: Create the local bill database and enable the dashboard card.

abort.not_setup: Bill Tracker is not loaded. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.category_not_found: The selected bill type no longer exists.
abort.payer_not_found: The selected payer no longer exists.
abort.parser_not_setup: Billy's automatic parser subsystem is not loaded. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.parser_not_found: The selected parser no longer exists.
abort.custom_parser_not_found: The selected parser is not a custom parser.

error.invalid_category: Check the bill type data. The name, recurrence, default payer or color may be invalid.
error.category_in_use: This bill type has history and cannot be deleted. Disable it instead.
error.invalid_payer: Check payer name and default share. A payer with this name may already exist.
error.payer_in_use: This payer is referenced by bills, bill defaults or settlements. Disable the payer instead.
error.parser_catalog_error: Billy could not download or validate parser.json from billy-parser.
error.parser_install_error: The parser could not be downloaded or installed. Check its checksum, schema and Billy compatibility.
error.custom_parser_error: The custom YAML parser is invalid or uses an unsupported instruction.

parser_sources.title: Email sources
parser_sources.description: Select the Home Assistant IMAP entries Billy may observe. Billy first checks sender/subject metadata against installed parser prefilters and fetches the body or PDF only after a match. Nothing is sent to the parser repository. If no IMAP entry is listed, add the IMAP integration first. Status: {imap_status}.

parser_refresh.title: Refresh parser catalog
parser_refresh.description: Download and validate parser.json from [billy-parser]({parser_project_url}). Parser YAML files are downloaded only when you explicitly install one.

parser_catalog.title: Parser catalog
parser_catalog.description: Choose a parser to install or update. Billy verifies the downloaded file size, SHA-256 checksum, parser ID and version.

parser_install.title: Install {name}
parser_install.description: Provider: {provider}. Map this parser to one of your Billy bill types. Automatic import is off by default; with it off, parsed bills wait for your review.

edit_parser.title: Configure {name}
edit_parser.description: Automatic import only runs when the parser result has no email/PDF verification conflict.

delete_parser.title: Remove {name}
delete_parser.description: Removing a parser does not remove bills that were already imported.

custom_parser.title: Create or update a custom parser
custom_parser.description: Paste a Billy parser schema v1 YAML document. Custom parsers are validated with the same restricted declarative engine as community parsers: no Python, JavaScript, shell, filesystem or arbitrary network access.

export_parser.title: Export {name}
export_parser.description: You can [download the YAML file directly]({download_url}) and submit it manually to billy-parser if you want to share it. The WebSocket endpoint `bill_tracker/parser/custom/export` also returns it as a Base64 payload.

parser_imports.title: Bills waiting for review
parser_imports.description: Approve a parsed bill to add it to Billy, or ignore it. If there are no choices, the review queue is empty.

add_payer.title: Add payer
add_payer.description: The default share is used as a weight when Billy automatically splits a bill between active payers.

edit_payer.title: Edit payer
edit_payer.description: Disabling a payer keeps all history but removes the payer from new automatic splits.

delete_payer.title: Delete {name}
delete_payer.description: Only a payer that has never been referenced can be deleted.

add_category.title: Add bill type
add_category.description: Choose recurrence, default payer, chart color and optional consumption unit. Consumption lets Billy compare provider/contract changes using cost per unit.

edit_category.title: Edit bill type
edit_category.description: The default payer is preselected for new bills. Set a consumption unit such as kWh or m³ to enable contract savings estimates. Disabling the type keeps its history.

delete_category.title: Delete {name}
delete_category.description: Only bill types with no history can be deleted.

support.title: Support Billy
support.description: If Billy is useful to you, you can [⭐ star the project on GitHub]({project_url}) or [☕ buy me a coffee with PayPal.Me]({support_url}). Both are completely optional — thanks for using Billy!

parser_manager.title: Parser management
parser_manager.description: Open the dedicated [parser management page]({parser_manager_url}) to install, update, configure or remove parsers. The page supports country/status filters, search, sorting and marks outdated parsers. Return here when you are done.
